title: SMProfile-OperationsDefinition payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/operations-definition.json 3.2.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

version_label.description: Business version identifier of the routing (independent of the profile SemVer).

article_ref.description: FK to Article.article_no, reached via OperationsSegment SPECIFIES_MATERIAL. The article that this routing manufactures.

product_definition_ref.description: FK to ProductDefinition.product_definition_no (the reference lives in this key, no ISA-95 edge — owner 25.09.). The target-parameter / recipe binding of the article.

operations_material_bill_ref.description: The OperationsMaterialBill (HAS_MATERIAL_BILL; ISA-95 OperationsDefinition → OperationsMaterialBill). Optional.

operations_type.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

bill_of_materials_ref.description: The bill of materials in the system that owns it (PLM or ERP) this definition builds from — its id there, never a copy of the BOM.

effective_start.description: From when this operations definition is valid (effectivity by date). An effectivity by serial number, lot or unit is no date and has no B2MML field (an extension of its own, PLAN-0700 L5).

effective_end.description: Until when this operations definition is valid.

published_date.description: When this operations definition was released by the system that owns it.

engineering_change_ref.description: The engineering change (ECN, SAP change number) that released this operations definition.
